entries.b579070d8ac7367a: This business operates “Mori-juku,” a tutoring-style cram school for elementary, junior high and high school students in which one teacher instructs up to two students. For junior high school students, it has introduced a “grade guarantee program” that guarantees a rise of 20 points or more in one subject on regular exams. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥18,562 million, and as of September 30, 2025, it operated 249 directly managed campuses.
entries.b961b5e33b01e133: In the education services industry, while the declining birthrate advances, education system reform is progressing, and the need for new forms of education and instruction using IT technology is increasing. Responses to the diversification of the examination environment, such as the effective free tuition for private high schools, school-recommendation admissions and comprehensive selection, are also required. Net sales to external customers of the group in the fiscal year ended September 2025 were Mori Juku ¥18,562 million, Shonan Seminar ¥9,295 million, Kawaijuku Manavis ¥3,355 million, and other ¥3,914 million, with the individual instruction-type Mori Juku being the largest.
